column1: # D1 generation-and-control gate: matched statistical generators against the profile oracle.
# CPU only, on Compute, and deliberately so. The gate reuses the frozen 800-attempt
# generation ledgers and the already reported structure contrasts, so it needs no model
# inference and no card; the one instrument it runs is HMMER against the staged Pfam-A,
# which is the same non-neural oracle the conditioned-generation campaign used and which
# lives on this host rather than in a pod. Nothing here folds a structure, and nothing
# here may be run in the ESMFold2 runtime.
# The five phases are ordered and each is resumable. Phase 1 makes one seeded pass over
# the whole staged UniRef50 and must complete before phase 2; phase 3 is the only
# expensive cell and skips any shard whose table already binds its own FASTA digest.
# Phase 4 needs no oracle output and may run beside phase 3.
# Columns: index, campaign tag, lane, script, cell, environment, output, arguments.
